source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and provider model pages; values vary by reasoning effort and provider.

luna.aa_snapshot: GPT-5.6 Luna (max): Intelligence Index 38; $0.18 per Index task; 115 output tokens/s.
luna.route_when: The task is high-volume, bounded, and has a clear output schema; minimizing cost matters more than deepest reasoning.
luna.avoid_when: The task needs difficult multi-file planning, nuanced trade-offs, or expensive-to-retry judgment.

terra.aa_snapshot: GPT-5.6 Terra (max): Intelligence Index 42; $1.40 per Index task; 85 output tokens/s.
terra.route_when: The task is a normal, well-scoped daily coding, writing, or analysis job needing a balance of quality and cost.
terra.avoid_when: A cheaper bounded model is sufficient, or the work is an unusually complex professional decision.

sol.aa_snapshot: GPT-5.6 Sol (xhigh): Intelligence Index 44; $1.18 per Index task; 67 output tokens/s.
sol.route_when: The task requires strong professional reasoning: tricky debugging, multi-file refactoring, or difficult technical trade-offs.
sol.avoid_when: The task is routine or high-volume enough that a lower-cost tier will meet the acceptance criteria.

haiku.aa_snapshot: Claude 4.5 Haiku (reasoning): Intelligence Index 18; $0.21 per Index task; 89 output tokens/s.
haiku.route_when: The task is a fast, bounded Anthropic-compatible extraction, classification, or concise transformation at scale.
haiku.avoid_when: The task has complicated planning, deep repository context, or high consequence from a wrong answer.

sonnet.aa_snapshot: Claude Sonnet 5 (max): Intelligence Index 38; up to $5.09 per Index task; 75 output tokens/s.
sonnet.route_when: The task is a well-scoped default implementation, research, writing, or agent task where consistent general capability matters.
sonnet.avoid_when: A simple scale task fits Haiku/Luna, or a difficult professional decision justifies Opus or Sol.

opus.aa_snapshot: Claude Opus 5 (max): Intelligence Index 51; up to $5.86 per Index task; 51 output tokens/s.
opus.route_when: The task is a difficult but bounded professional judgment, high-stakes review, or multi-system diagnosis where retries are costly.
opus.avoid_when: The task is routine, easily verified, or high-volume.
